metadata.name: GetMerchantAccountParameter
metadata.description: This API is Used to get the Merchant Account Parameters.

request_fields.name: Source
request_fields.description: Source of API Consumer For external system expected sources will be WEB. Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: IPAddress
request_fields.description: IP Address of Client / Application Hosting Server Example: 10.206.0.204 Allowable Values: 15

request_fields.name: DateFormat
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Values are: 1 : MM/dd/yyyy HH:MM:SS (Default) 2 : MM/dd/yy HH:MM:SS 3 : dd/MM/yyyy HH:MM:SS Allowable Values: 25

request_fields.name: CurrencyCode
request_fields.description: Currency Code Place Holder for Future Use. Valid Values: Refer Appendix Section - Currency Code Example:840 = US Dollar Condition:If no value is passed, default value = 840 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CurrencySymbolType
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. CurrencySymbolType: 1: Currency Sign like $ 2: 3 ALPHA Currency Code like USD Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: Language
request_fields.description: Place Holder for Future Use. Language: en: means use English Default: en - English Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: ExternalIP
request_fields.description: IP Address of end user of API Allowable Values: 50

request_fields.name: SessionID
request_fields.description: Session identifier of the API Example: 000028;026;1349906692 Allowable Values: 100

request_fields.name: APIVersion
request_fields.description: Version of the API to be invoked. Example: 2.0 API Version Current Version 2.0 Allowable Values: 10

request_fields.name: CallerID
request_fields.description: Caller ID of source from where API is initiated it is End User Caller ID Example: 7204454214 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: CalledID
request_fields.description: Called ID of destination for which API is initiated It is Destination Called ID Example: 7314145404 (phone number applicable in Case of IVR) Allowable Values: 20

request_fields.name: RequestTime
request_fields.description: Request Date Time of API Format: MM/dd/yyyy HH:mm:ss Example:01/15/2020 10:05:23

request_fields.name: MerchantID
request_fields.description: Unique number of merchant account Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition: Mandatory If MerchantNumber not Inputted in API Request

request_fields.name: MerchantNumber
request_fields.description: Merchant Number which is assgined to a Merchant Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345 Condition: Mandatory If MerchantID not Inputted in API Request Allowable Values: 10

response_fields.name: CurrencySymbol
response_fields.description: This tag reflects the currency symbol

response_fields.name: Status
response_fields.description: API Status Example: Success - true, Error - false

response_fields.name: ErrorCode
response_fields.description: Response Message Error Code Allowable Values: 10

children.name: MerchantID
children.description: Unique number of merchant account Valid Values:0-9 Format:XXXXX Example:12345

children.name: BillingCycle
children.description: The Billing Cycle Assigned for the Merchant

children.name: StatementPrintingSequence
children.description: Indicates in what Sequence/order the Statement must be Printed Valid Values: '0' = Account Number Order and '1' = ZIP Code Order Format: X Example: 0

children.name: StatementForm
children.description: Indicates the Statement printed will be as a Form or Custom Made Valid Values: '0' = Form and '1' = Custom Format: X Example: 0

children.name: CreditLimitOTBDisplay
children.description: Determines if the Credit Limit and OTB will be Displayed on Merchant Statement or Not. Valid Values: 0-Display on Statement 1-Do not display on Statement Format: X Example: 0

children.name: DefaultCreditLimit
children.description: Default Credit Limit Assigned for the Merchant Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 1000.00

children.name: SumofAllCredits
children.description: Indicates Sum of All Credits Valid Values: 0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 1000.00

children.name: InventoryGroupCode
children.description: Inventory Group Code for the Merchant Valid Values: a-z Format: X Example: abc xyz

children.name: MSRPolicyIdentifier
children.description: Credit Policy on the Merchant Valid Values: '1' = Grandfathered and '2' = Standard Format: X Example: 0

children.name: MSRLineAssignmentPolicy
children.description: Line Assignment Policy on the Merchant Valid Values: '1' = Grandfathered and '2' = Standard Format: X Example: 0 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: ProductMapping
children.description: Indicates the Products Mapped on the Merchant, Multiple Products can be mapped on the Merchant by Inputting Product IDs comma Seperated Check the Product IDs provided by CoreCARD Valid Values: 0-9 Format:XXXXXX,XXXXX Example:12345,54321 Allowable Values: 100

children.name: HoldAccountStatus1
children.description: Account with status set on the Field, will be eligible of Reserve Calculation, conditon, the same status must be in the Included Status Field and also 'Add Unmailed to Reserve' Filed must be set to Yes in Merchant Reserve Parameters Valid Values: Status Code refer the Appendix Allowable Values: 50

children.name: HoldAccountStatus2
children.description: Account with status set on the Field, the Statement generated for Account with this Status will be Sent to the Merchant and Not the Account Holder and such Accounts will be eligible of Reserve Calculation, Reserve Calculation conditon, the same status must be in the Included Status Field and also "Add Unmailed to Reserve" Filed must be set to Yes in Merchant Reserve Parameters Allowable Values: 50

children.name: HoldAccountStatus3
children.description: Account with status set on the Field, the Statement generated for Account with this Status will be Sent to the Merchant and Not the Account Holder and such Accounts will be eligible of Reserve Calculation, Reserve Calculation conditon, the same status must be in the Included Status Field and also "Add Unmailed to Reserve" Filed must be set to Yes in Merchant Reserve Parameters Allowable Values: 50

children.name: HoldAccountStatus4
children.description: Account with status set on the Field, the Statement generated for Account with this Status will be Sent to the Merchant and Not the Account Holder and such Accounts will be eligible of Reserve Calculation, Reserve Calculation conditon, the same status must be in the Included Status Field and also "Add Unmailed to Reserve" Filed must be set to Yes in Merchant Reserve Parameters Allowable Values: 50

children.name: HoldCreditBalances
children.description: If Set to Yes then if All account available under the Merchant with Negative Current Balance will be Eligible for Reserve calculations, Condition this field will be honoured for the Account only if the status of the Account is not in one of the "HoldAccountStatus" fields in Merchant Account Parameters and also in "IncludedStatus" fields in Merchant Reserve Parameters Valid Values: '0' = Yes and '1' = No Format: X Example: 0 Allowable Values: 50

children.name: DebitBalancesUnder
children.description: If any Account has Current Balance Greater than 0 and Lower than the Amount set this field/tag, then it will be Eligible for Reserve calculations, Condition this field will be honoured if 'HoldCreditBalances' is set to 'No' and if the status of the Account is not in one of the 'HoldAccountStatus' fields in Merchant Account Parameters and also in 'IncludedStatus' fields in Merchant Reserve Parameters. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXX.XX Example: 500.00

children.name: FromAccountNumber
children.description: If any Account Number falls between from This Account Number to Account Number set in "ToAccountNumber", it will be eligible for Reserve calculations, Condition this field will be honoured if "HoldCreditBalances" is set to 'No' and if the status of the Account is not in one of the "HoldAccountStatus" fields in Merchant Account Parameters and also in "IncludedStatus" fields in Merchant Reserve Parameters Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 9000000111111222222333 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: ToAccountNumber
children.description: If any Account Number falls between the  Account Number in "FromAccountNUmber" to Account Number set in "ToAccountNumber", it will be eligible for Reserve calculations, Condition this field will be honoured if "HoldCreditBalances" is set to 'No' and if the status of the Account is not in one of the "HoldAccountStatus" fields in Merchant Account Parameters and also in "IncludedStatus" fields in Merchant Reserve Parameters Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 9000000111111222222333 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AccountNumberGenerationFlag
children.description: If Set To Yes then Account Number will be Auto Generated for the Accounts Created Under this Merchant Valid Values: '0' = Yes and '1' = No Format: X Example: 0 Allowable Values: 4

children.name: AccountNumberBegin
children.description: For internally-generated account numbers, this is the first account number that can be issued for this Merchant. This number is added to the number in the Increment By field to generate the first account number. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 0000000000001000 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AccountNumberEnd
children.description: For internally-generated card numbers, this is the last account number that can be issued for this Merchant Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 0000000000001000 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AccountNumberIncrementBy
children.description: The Begin Number is added to this number to generate the first account number. Subsequent account numbers are generated by adding the Last Used Account Number to this number.

children.name: AccountNumberLastUsed
children.description: The last generated account number displays in this field/Tag, which is used to generate the next account number by adding the value in the Increment By field to this number. Valid Values:0-9 Format: XXXXXXXXXXXXXXX Example: 0000000000001000 Allowable Values: 19

children.name: AccountNumberCheckDigitRoutine
children.description: Determines the Modulous formula applied for Check Digit Routine Valid Values: '0'= Mod10, '1' = Mod11 and '2' = None Format: X Example: 2 Allowable Values: 10
